features.title: Secure Data Encryption

faqs.question: What types of data can Azure Backup protect?
faqs.answer: Azure Backup protects Azure VMs, SQL databases, Windows/Linux servers, and on-premises workloads.

faqs.question: How does Azure Backup ensure data security?
faqs.answer: Data is encrypted at rest and in transit, with support for Azure Key Vault and customer-managed keys.

faqs.question: Can I restore individual files from a backup?
faqs.answer: Yes, Azure Backup provides granular file-level recovery for quick restoration.
